notes.title: English Translation: Now Avaliable!
notes.notes: [p]Good evening everyone, future VIPs of the [i]Fleabag[/i] pub![/p][p][/p][p]We have some big news we've been dying to share with our entire community. After a lot of hard work and chugging a few energy juices, we are thrilled to announce that...[/p][p][b]The demo for After Juice: Animal Disco Mafia is now fully translated and available in ENGLISH![/b][/p][p]We know many of you were eagerly waiting to be able to understand Tofu's bad jokes in your own language, and that day has finally come! Now, you can join the party too.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Are you a new party animal?[/b][/p][p]For those who have just arrived in the city, After Juice: Animal Disco Mafia is a narrative adventure where you step into the skin (or rather, the fur) of [b]Tofu[/b], a small hamster with big dreams and even worse life choices. Get ready to:[/p][list][*][p]🐹 Experience the craziest adventures of college night life. [/p][/*][*][p]🌃 Explore a vibrant city full of parties, mystery, and memorable characters. [/p][/*][*][p]😂 Laugh out loud at our unique sense of humor and embarrasingly bad animal puns. [/p][/*][*][p]🕺 Uncover the secrets hidden in the city of Furrol after dark.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Your feedback is very important![/b][/p][p]Now that the demo is available to everyone, your feedback is more valuable than ever. We want to make the final release experience the best it can be. So please, don't hesitate to:[/p][list][*][p][b]Download the demo[/b] from our Steam page.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Play and immerse yourself[/b] in the adventure of Tofu and company.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Add the game to your Wishlist[/b] if you enjoyed it. It helps us out a lot![/p][/*][*][p][b]Leave us your comments[/b] on the community forums. What did you like? Which joke was so bad it actually made you laugh like a hyena? We want to know everything![/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your incredible support. We can't wait to see all your funny reactions to our little game![/p][p]See you on the dance floor 😎 [/p][p][/p][p][b]Virtual Seed.[/b][/p]
